provenance.product: Terrarium PNG tiles, zoom 12 (mixed SRTM/3DEP/GMTED/ETOPO sources)
provenance.hashScope: SHA-256 of each PNG tile as downloaded

source.verticalReference: unverified (mixed-source Terrain Tiles; nominally metres above mean sea level)

axes: X east, Y up, Z south (metres)

lod.framings: core tiles meet the pixel budget at their closest unoccluded approach; extended-only tiles at budgetScale x; hidden tiles are not drawn

poses.detail: each pose with its own lens at its own closest unoccluded approach; mirror poses at the mirror resolution, ground at and below the water clipped

lod.triangulation: quads split along the (0,0)-(1,1) diagonal; finer edges snap to the coarser neighbour

hydrology.flow: log2(D8 accumulation over depression-filled heights) * 16, capped 254
hydrology.water: none: the view declares its flats are not water
